title: Euler liars among residues
statement: Let $N>1$ be an odd composite integer. Among the integers $A$ with $1\le A<N$ that are coprime to $N$ and satisfy $\left(\frac{A}{N}\right)\equiv A^{(N-1)/2}\pmod N$, at most $(N-1)/2$ have this property.
